question: What is the title of the post with the oldest post link?
evidence: the oldest post link refers to MIN(CreaionDate);
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching postLinks record.
gold: SELECT T1.Title FROM posts AS T1 LEFT JOIN postLinks AS T2 ON T2.PostId = T1.Id ORDER BY T1.CreaionDate LIMIT 1
gold0: SELECT T1.Title FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN postLinks AS T2 ON T2.PostId = T1.Id ORDER BY T1.CreaionDate LIMIT 1

b.request: What is the title of the post with the earliest `CreaionDate`, including posts with no matching `postLinks` record?
b.sql: SELECT Title FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CreaionDate ASC, Id ASC LIMIT 1;

d.request: What are the titles of posts with the oldest post link, including posts with no matching postLinks record?
d.sql: WITH oldest_link AS (SELECT MIN(CreationDate) AS oldest_date FROM postLinks) SELECT DISTINCT p.Title FROM posts AS p LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl ON pl.PostId = p.Id CROSS JOIN oldest_link AS o WHERE pl.CreationDate = o.oldest_date OR pl.Id IS NULL

c.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.Title FROM posts AS p LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl ON pl.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.CreaionDate = (SELECT MIN(CreaionDate) FROM posts)
